event_linking: After talks are written here, python3 tools/event_backfill.py looks up an existing calendar or backfill event on series, date span, city, country and organiser, then creates a previous event when the video page states the day, the place, the type and the organiser. A talk that cannot be dated or placed stays unlinked with unlink_reason.

One video (Andreas M. Antonopoulos at Oslo Blockchain Day 2017) was opened from its URL directly, so candidates_checked is 1132 and watch_pages_opened is 183. 74 talks were kept. YouTube's watch-page player asked for a sign-in and omitted lengthSeconds; duration is the lengthText on YouTube's own search result for that video id, except yt-eo-0BgrKxiI, which was not in a search result and has a null duration. embed is the YouTube oEmbed iframe flag. Spoken language was not labelled on the pages we kept, so language is null.
